quotes.text: Security isn't about any single product. It's about connecting the dots across everything happening in your environment.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States the core idea behind extended detection and response.

quotes.text: Defender XDR isn't some brand new product you have to go out and buy. It's more like a unifying layer that sits on top of security tools you might already own.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Corrects a common misconception about what Defender XDR is.

quotes.text: The detection in one place strengthens protection everywhere else. That's a level of coordination you simply cannot build by buying separate tools from different vendors.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the multiplier effect of native integration.

quotes.text: Attackers can lurk inside a network for days before anyone notices. With XDR, that window shrinks to hours or even minutes. And in security, time is the one thing you never get back.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Makes the case for speed as the decisive security factor.

quotes.text: Email is still the number one way attackers get into organizations. Blocking those threats at the gateway is the highest leverage move you can make.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete, prioritised recommendation for where to start.

takeaways: Microsoft Defender XDR is a unifying layer that correlates signals from Defender for Endpoint, Office 365, Identity, Cloud Apps and vulnerability management into single incidents.
Correlated incidents and automated remediation cut alert noise and can shrink response times from hours to minutes.
Start by checking your Microsoft 365 licensing, turn on the unified incident experience and deploy the Defender for Office 365 preset policies before adding more components.
hook: Separate alerts from email, identity and endpoint tools hide the one attack that connects them. This episode explains Microsoft Defender XDR, its five building blocks and how they combine into single incidents with automated response, for IT and security teams using Microsoft 365. You also get three concrete steps to unlock protection you may already be paying for.
